goal: docs/specs/next16-migration/validation.md records the Next.js 16 migration on main as a sign-off checklist, every line marked met, not met or not run with its evidence, including smoke coverage of critical routes, the force-dynamic fallback, proposed rollback triggers and the not-run performance spot-checks with their commands.
out_of_scope: app/, components/, layouts/, lib/, css/, data/, public/, scripts/, tests/: no site code, content, script or test changes
package.json, package-lock.json, next.config.js, contentlayer.config.ts and other configuration
docs/specs/next16-migration/blockers.md and readiness.md: the new document notes blockers.md is stale; correcting it is a follow-up
removing or re-adding force-dynamic; adding smoke coverage for /about
running Lighthouse or the Playwright smoke on the PC; committing Lighthouse output
adopting rollback thresholds: they are recorded as proposed; adoption is the developer's
acceptance: test -f docs/specs/next16-migration/validation.md && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh lint && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh test

tasks.title: Write the Next.js 16 migration sign-off checklist
tasks.description: Create docs/specs/next16-migration/validation.md with the structure and format rules in design.md D2: the seven headings and the two performance subsections with their exact text, rows V1-V13 each with a plain Status cell of met, not met or not run (D1) and its evidence, the 'Proposed, not adopted' note and triggers R1-R4. Re-check each cited fact against the merge base with origin/main before writing it. Record the PC lint and test results in V5 and V6, citing the merge-base commit and the run date. Never mark V7-V13 met. Verified by test -f; grep for every heading and subsection; every row V1-V13 with a valid status; V4 met; V7, V8, V9, V12 and V13 not run; no row V7-V13 met; 'Proposed, not adopted' and R1-R4; 60a7a1f, /about and the Lighthouse command; then the lint pipeline check.
tasks.acceptance: f=docs/specs/next16-migration/validation.md; test -f "$f" && grep -q '^# Next.js 16 Migration Validation' "$f" && grep -q '^## Status legend' "$f" && grep -q '^## Sign-off checklist' "$f" && grep -q '^## Smoke coverage of critical routes' "$f" && grep -q '^## force-dynamic fallback' "$f" && grep -q '^## Rollback triggers (proposed)' "$f" && grep -q '^## Performance spot-checks' "$f" && grep -qxF '### Homepage (/)' "$f" && grep -qxF '### Blog post page' "$f" && for i in $(seq 1 13); do grep -qE "^\| *V$i *\|[^|]*\| *(met|not met|not run) *\|" "$f" || exit 1; done && grep -qE '^\| *V4 *\|[^|]*\| *met *\|' "$f" && for i in 7 8 9 12 13; do grep -qE "^\| *V$i *\|[^|]*\| *not run *\|" "$f" || exit 1; done && ! grep -qE '^\| *V(7|8|9|10|11|12|13) *\|[^|]*\| *met *\|' "$f" && grep -qF 'Proposed, not adopted' "$f" && for r in 1 2 3 4; do grep -qE "^- \*\*R$r\b" "$f" || exit 1; done && grep -qF '60a7a1f' "$f" && grep -qF '/about' "$f" && grep -qF 'npx -y lighthouse' "$f" && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh lint

tasks.title: Confirm the change writes only the checklist and its plan
tasks.description: Compare the whole branch against the merge base with origin/main: every tracked path that differs, and every untracked non-ignored path (top-level sandbox dot-entries excluded, .github and .husky included; design.md D4), must be docs/specs/next16-migration/validation.md or under openspec/changes/p1h-240-site-record-the-next-js-16/. Then run the unit tests. Verified by filtering git diff --name-only and git ls-files --others against those two paths and requiring nothing left, then the test pipeline check.
tasks.acceptance: b="$(git merge-base HEAD refs/remotes/origin/main)" && l="$(git diff --name-only "$b" && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- . ':(exclude,glob).*' && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- .github .husky)" && test -z "$(printf '%s\n' "$l" | grep -vxE 'docs/specs/next16-migration/validation\.md|openspec/changes/p1h-240-site-record-the-next-js-16/.+')" && bash scripts/pipeline-check.sh test
